verdict: Ads have been paused 19 days; reactivation and overdue builds are underway.
narrative: Paid campaigns went dark on September 17 and have not run since, which is why lead volume, spend, and paid traffic all read zero for the back half of this 28-day window. The 48 leads and $16.20 cost per lead shown in the totals were earned before the pause. In parallel, eight project milestones that unlock proper attribution and scaling — some overdue since late July — are being worked through now in priority order. Google Ads conversion tracking is also being repaired; the $201 spent there under-reports results until that fix is confirmed live. The focus for the next period is reactivating Meta campaigns and closing the milestone backlog so scaling decisions are based on clean data.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta before campaigns paused on Sep 17
cost per lead while Meta was running — a strong efficiency baseline to build from
consecutive days with campaigns paused, the central issue being resolved now

watch_item.issue: Meta campaigns have been fully paused since September 17, halting all paid lead flow; Google Ads conversion tracking is not recording results.
watch_item.fix: Campaigns are being reactivated and conversion tracking repaired this week, with eight overdue build milestones being closed in sequence to unblock attribution and scaling.
